summary: Implementation Design handoff for Business Service: Diagram Editing Service (biz-service-editing). The coding stage must produce a new Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite desktop application with 7 orthogonal concerns (A–G). The existing Python Flask web app (src/plantuml_gui/) must be retained but stripped to only /render and /renderPNG endpoints. All new Electron/React code lives under new src/ directories. Acceptance tests are physicalized as Playwright E2E and Vitest unit test files. All testfiles are expected to fail initially (code does not exist yet). The Python backend's existing activity/sequence manipulation endpoints are removed; TypeScript AST handles all parsing, generation, and editing logic.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Exit code non-zero or type compilation errors for AST types
codingTargets.nextAction: Define all AST types (ActivityNode, IfNode, WhileNode, ForkNode, SwitchNode, ContainerNode, DiagramModel, EdgeData) with strict TypeScript. Ensure ContainerNode has children array. DiagramModel has nodes[] and edges[]. EdgeData references source/target node ids.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Round-trip test fails: serialization produces different output than input
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement toJSON/fromJSON on DiagramModel. Ensure all node types serialize/deserialize correctly with positions, hierarchy, and edges.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Parsed AST does not match expected structure for sample Activity Diagram PlantUML
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement stack-based nesting tracking. Support @startuml/@enduml, :Action;, if/else/endif, while/endwhile, fork/endfork, split/endsplit. Use forward/backward scanning for block boundaries.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Round-trip parse→generate→parse does not preserve all elements
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement depth-tracked indentation. Generate valid PlantUML for all AST node types. Ensure re-import of generated text produces identical AST.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Custom node types do not render or are positioned incorrectly
codingTargets.nextAction: Create ReactFlow custom node renderers for each node type (StartNode, StopNode, ActivityNode, IfNode, WhileNode, ForkNode, SwitchNode). Use ReactFlow's position property for placement.

codingTargets.failureSignal: One or more drag-and-drop levels do not work
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement onDrop handler for palette→canvas (new node at drop coords). Implement onNodeDragStop for reposition. Implement connect handler for connector handle→edge creation.

codingTargets.failureSignal: PlantUML keywords not highlighted or editor not functional
codingTargets.nextAction: Wrap react-ace with PlantUML mode definition. Use mode-plantuml.js or define Ace mode inline. Ensure line numbers visible and editor is read/write.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Debounce does not fire or fires too frequently
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement useEditorEvents hook with 200ms debounce. Emit full text content on each event. Use lodash.debounce or custom debounce.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Last-write-wins does not preserve the later edit
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement SyncEngine with version numbers and timestamps. On sync trigger, compare timestamps. Later edit overwrites earlier. Regenerate the other representation.

Implement fingerprint matching. Compute fingerprint from element type + label + nesting path. Persist positions in .puml.meta sidecar. Restore positions on re-import. Default grid layout for unmatchable elements.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Palette categories not displayed or items not draggable
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement left-panel Palette with 3 collapsible category sections. Each section contains draggable items. Implement drag preview on hover.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Python backend subprocess not spawned or not cleaned up
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement Python backend subprocess manager. Spawn PyInstaller exe (or python dev script) on first export trigger. Health-check via /health. Graceful shutdown via SIGTERM on app close.

codingTargets.nextAction: Integrate all concerns in App.tsx: Palette on left, Canvas center, Code Editor on right. Wire sync engine. Wire menu actions. Ensure full workflow: add→arrange→connect→sync→export.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Dependency-driven incremental build. Foundation concerns (A, E) first, then infrastructure (G), then UI concerns (B, C, F), then integration (D). Finally Python backend stripping and installer setup. Each task produces compilable/runnable output before moving to the next. Tasks with dependsOn wait for completion signals from predecessors.

openGaps: The Python backend stripping strategy (TASK-12) requires careful handling: the existing src/plantuml_gui/ has ~40 endpoints across activity/, sequence/, and shared/ blueprints. The handoff recommends creating a new minimal src/python-backend/ with only /render and /renderPNG endpoints, keeping the old backend as reference until migration is complete.

Playwright Electron support (@playwright/test + electron) must be installed and configured. The handoff tests/e2e/ scripts assume Playwright can launch and control the built Electron app. This setup must be validated on Windows 10/11.
The project currently has no package.json at root level (Python-only project). TASK-01 must create one. This will introduce npm as a build dependency alongside uv/pip.
The JRE download (jlink minimal ~40MB) requires a trusted download source. The handoff recommends GitHub Releases or the Adoptium API. The exact URL must be confirmed and hardcoded in TASK-11.
The PlantUML JAR download (~20MB) requires a trusted download source (Maven Central or PlantUML GitHub releases). The exact URL must be confirmed in TASK-11.
The fingerprint-based sidecar file (.puml.meta) strategy from the intent handoff open question is adopted. The SidecarStore in TASK-09 must handle concurrent access and file locking for safety.

The Undo/Redo mechanism for canvas edits is not explicitly defined in the intent graph but is required by TC-G-1 (Edit→Undo/Redo). The coding stage must implement canvas edit history with Command pattern or ReactFlow's built-in undo/redo.
The project's existing Python tests (tests/activity/, tests/sequence/, tests/e2e/) test the Flask web app. These must be updated or removed as part of TASK-12 to avoid false-positive test runs.

Architecture test runner currently only supports .py, .js, .cjs, .mjs, .ps1, .cmd, .bat extensions. Vitest TypeScript tests (.ts) are not directly supported. The handoff uses .mjs wrapper scripts that invoke Vitest or compiled TypeScript. This approach must be validated during TASK-14.

All 46 acceptance testcases have been physicalized to stub .mjs scripts that exit with failure (expected). TASK-14 must update each stub with real test logic that validates the implementation. The acceptanceCriteria field in SystemArchitecture.json has been updated to point to these scripts.
The ImplementationToIntentTraceProposal.json documents the acceptanceCriteria updates applied to the intent graph and proposes trace links from intent elements to implementation directories.
